system.description:
Tye dashes into the enemy fortress full of rage and his blood boiling. “GIVE HER BACK!” he screams as his eyes glow with an emerald green hue. He swipes his hand towards an enemy guard, as a wave of Chakra leaps from it chopping them in half with a blade of Wind. The enemies quickly try to seal the doors within the fortress but find it difficult as the angry boy weaves hand seals and exhales a gale of slicing Wind that blows the layered doors apart. He continues further in, before he is confronted by the man he lost to prior. “You throw away the kindness I showed you before boy. You are a fool.” He barks. But Tye doesn’t budge, as Chakra begins to coat his body with enough potency to be visible to the naked eye. The man is caught off guard with the sudden change, but Tye doesn’t hesitate as he rushes in ready to tear this man in half.

—Nina Heroshi

The Long Road, Ch. 25 excerpt.

Blood of the Dragon

Tag: Homebrew, Creator: Kingsare4ever

The Ryu Clan also known as the Dragon Clan were seen as a barbaric tribe of warriors, mercenaries and conquerors from the Land of Dragons. After the Three Clan War, the Land of Dragons would revolt, leading to a near genocide of the Ryu clan, causing their remnant to scatter and escape extinction. A group of these clansmen went south, learning the ways of Ninshou and has since settle in the Land of Mountains.

The Ryu has the unique bloodline simply called Blood of the Dragon or Ryuki, Draconic Chakra. This Bloodline allows all Clansmen to manifest a nature transformation at birth, but unlike normal nature transformations, this transformation is more savage, brutal, violent. Children cry fire, scream thunder and whine storms. Not enough to cause harm, but enough to show that this clan has a strong connection to nature transformations. This Kekkei Genkai also has a negative trait, that manifests in the younger members of the clan, being that their anger and rage is unmatched.

Ryu Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase (Select one):

Primal Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Con

Empyreal Dragon: +2 Str, +1 Con

Omen Dragon: +2 Int, +1 Str

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Martial Arts, Chakra Control

Dragon Kings Techniques: The Ryu Clan have access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list.

Hijutsu Flexibility: Ryu Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Draconic Power: Ryu Hijutsu you cast cannot have their cost increased by hostile effects or conditions.

Ryu Features

Wrath of the Dragon

1st Level Clan Feature

Born with the blood of dragons running through your veins you have a natural affinity to one of 5 chakra transformations. Beginning at 1st level, Choose between Earth, Wind, Fire, Water or Lightning Release. You can learn and cast jutsu with the chosen release and all of your Ryu Clan jutsu gains the chosen keyword and deals the same damage as the chosen nature releases damage type unless otherwise stated.

This inherent connection the elements is possible through your clans unique bloodline heritage, Draconic Chakra. You have a number of Draconic Chakra equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can spend this Draconic Chakra for features and abilities that call for it, such as unleashing your Dragon’s Rage. You can regain 1 Draconic Chakra once per turn, when you inflict a hostile creature with your chosen nature releases associated condition. You regain all spent Draconic Chakra when you complete a rest of any type.

Also, as a Bonus Action you can spend 2 Draconic Chakra to enter your Dragon’s Rage. Your eyes shift colors and chakra like scales form over your skin. Both your scales and eyes are all a color that matches your Draconic Chakra (Brown = Earth, Emerald = Wind, Red = Fire, Blue = Water, Gold = Lightning). You can maintain your Dragon’s Rage for one minute. You can dismiss it at no action on your turn. If you have 3 or more ranks of Sealed, your Dragon’s Rage state forcibly ends.

Your Dragon’s Rage grows with you as you grow in level, beginning at 7th level, you can spend 4 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in the Dragon’s Rage state, to become Ascended. Beginning at 15th level, you can spend 6 Draconic Chakra or an additional 2 Draconic Chakra if you are already in your Ascended Dragon’s Rage state, to become Awakened.

| #### Dragons Rage / Battle Amp / Draconic Presence. You gain a +1 bonus to your AC and a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to +2 AC and +20 speed at 15th level. / Dragon Claws. Your [Unarmed Damage] damage type becomes your chosen nature releases damage type. / Wyrm Surge. Non Hijutsu you cast with your chosen nature release gains the Wyrm Surge Keyword as part of their casting. Jutsu with this keyword will always inflict 1 rank of their associated condition on a failed save or if the attack is a critical hit, unless the jutsu already inflicts the associated condition on a failure. This increases to 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at15th level. (Earth Release: Shaken, Wind Release: Bleed, Fire Release: Burned, Water Release: Chilled, Lightning Release: Shocked). / Ascended (7th Level +) / Superior Release. When you Clash using a jutsu with your chosen nature release keyword, you gain a rank of Mastery to the check. This increases to two ranks at 15th level. / Seal Consumption. While in Dragons Rage, at the end of each of your turns, remove 1 rank of a Mental Condition you have, and gain 4 Temporary Chakra Points if you do. / Awakened (15th Level +) / Unbound Savagery. Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast cannot have its damage reduced or altered by hostile jutsu effects or conditions you may have. / Draconic Supremacy. Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast at D-Rank, are cast at no Chakra cost. |

Ryūken

1st Level Clan Feature

The Ryu clan has never fought with a tempered goal, or with modesty or with sportsmanship in mind. Their style of fighting was always desperate, ruthless and even a little underhanded. Their style embodies the ferocity of a starving dragon. You learn the Ryūken Taijutsu stance, which uses your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage]. While in this stance you gain the following benefits;

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes a d6 and can deal Slashing or Piercing damage as you treat each hand as a claw or dragon fang.

In place of an attack made as part of your Attack Action, you can instead make a Rending Strike or a Starving Strike. Alternatively, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra, you can use a Strike ability as part of a Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast., applying their saving throw on a successful hit or failed saving throw.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

Rending Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage], and forcing the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, their AC is reduced by 1, as you rend their defenses, until the beginning of your next turn. This increases to a 2 AC reduction at 7th level and a 3 AC reduction at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Starving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as Chakra damage, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, you forcefully drain them of chakra, using your Draconic Chakra to tear it from them, like flesh on the bone. You gain 2 Temporary chakra, until the end of the current turn. This increases to 4 Temporary chakra at 7th level and 6 temporary chakra at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Tyrants Dominion

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your strength, unrivaled. Your savagery, unmatched. You fight better. You strike harder. You move faster. Everything that the suns light touches is yours. Your clan believed this in their past and part of you even believes it now. You express this in a series of Wyrm Arts. Special technique the Ryu clan demands its members master, to be prepared for the next clan war. You begin knowing two of these arts. You gain an additional one at 7th and 15th level. Effects that force a saving throw uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Sovereigns Ascent

As a bonus action, by spending 1 Draconic Chakra while you are standing on the ground, you can strike the ground with enough force to send you airborne, covered in Draconic Chakra. You gain a fly speed equal to your movement speed until the end of your next turn as your slowed descent can be confused for flight.

Sovereigns Brutality

Combat for you feeds something deep inside you. Something primal. Instinctual. Conflict drives you, and that drive ignites your passion for battle like an engine. At the beginning of your turn, if you have taken damage since the end of your last turn, your brutality is magnified. Attacks you make against creatures with ranks of Elemental or Physical conditions, gain a +1 bonus to their critical threat range. This increases by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Sovereigns Coil

As a reaction to taking damage from a Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to roar, releasing a shockwave of Draconic Chakra, cracking the ground and shattering glass. This force is enough to stave off the force of jutsu. You trigger a Clash vs the triggering jutsu, using your Chakra control.

Sovereigns Momentum

As an Action, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra to move forward in a 30-foot line, creating a vacuum of force, while covered in Draconic Chakra, passing through all creatures in your path. Make an unarmed attack, comparing the result vs the AC of all hostile creatures you passed through dealing your [Unarmed Damage] as normal. This unarmed attack can use your Rending Strike, Starving Strike or any Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art.

Ryūken – Cleaving Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons tail shredding through the ground and air. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Cleaving Strike.

Cleaving Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, reduce their DR by 4, until the end of your next turn. This penalty increases to 6 at 7th and 8 at 15th levels and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Ryūken – Consuming Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons maw biting and gouging at its prey. Once per turn, in place of an attack made as part of your Attack action, you can instead make a Consuming Strike.

Consuming Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit, and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature has one jutsu based effect of D-Rank or lower they are benefiting from dispelled as your Draconic Chakra eats away at it. The rank of jutsu this affects increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Ryūken – Rebelling Strike

Your Draconic Chakra roars, covering your striking limb, as you strike with it, the afterimage of Dragons claw ripping and tearing at their assailant. Once per turn, as a Reaction to taking damage from a hostile creature within your unarmed attack range, you can make a Rebelling Strike.

Rebelling Strike. Make two unarmed attacks against the triggering creature, each dealing your [Unarmed Damage] on a hit. If you hit at least once, you force the affected creature to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are pushed 20 feet back, fall prone and are Bruised and the damage you deal increases by +1d6 at 7th and 15th levels.

Tyrants Focus

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Focus ability.

Tyrants Focus. You gain immunity to effects that would force you to treat allied creatures as hostile, or force you to target allied creatures with harmful effects. Additionally, you cannot be Charmed by a hostile creature while in combat.

Tyrants Ferocity

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Ferocity ability.

Tyrants Ferocity. When you score a critical hit against a creature with a jutsu based attack you make, you can make one Rending Strike, Starving Strike or Strike ability granted by a Wyrm Art against the same creature.

Tyrants Hunger

Your Dragon’s Rage gains the Tyrants Hunger ability.

Tyrants Hunger. When you take damage from a jutsu with the associated nature release you chose as part of the Wrath of the Dragon clan feature, you can spend your reaction to consume some of it, like eating fire, lighting or stone, reducing the damage you take by 1 damage die and regaining Draconic Chakra equal to the rank of the triggering jutsu (D-Rank/C-Rank: 2, B-Rank/A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 6). Increase the damage you reduce by an additional damage die at 7th and 15th levels.

Wyrm Lords Ambition

7th Level Clan Feature

While the Ryu clan lost many things in the Three Clan War and its following exile. Its ambition for dominion over even the skies, has remained. By spending 1 minute focusing your Chakra outward, and spending 2 Draconic Chakra, you can extend your Draconic chakra to all willing allied creatures within 10 feet of you. Each creature gains draconic wings made of chakra that grants them 30 feet of flight for the next 10 minutes all linked to you. Once you use this feature to grant yourself or other creature flight, you cannot do so again until you complete a short or long rest.

If initiative is rolled while allied creatures are benefiting from this flight, at the beginning of their turns, they can choose to maintain or dismiss the wings. If they maintain it, they must continue to concentrate on them as if they are concentrating on an A-Rank jutsu. If they dismiss it, they float down slowly towards the ground.

Additionally, you learn to lean into the weight of your name. The stories commoners would speak of your families conquests would scare children and adults alike. When in a social encounter with a Non-combatant creature, such as a merchant, civilian, or minor official, revealing your clan heritage is enough to make one minor request without requiring a skill check, as they comply out of fear of what could happen if they don’t.

Any further requests require checks and skill-based actions as normal.

Dragon Kings Legacy

11th Level Clan Feature

The Ryu who stand today are descendants of the survivors of the Three Clan war. Those who survived the bloodiest 10-day conflict in the Northern Bestial Nations history. Your genes remember this blood feud and you have tapped into the methods of survival your ancestors used to make it through their conflict.

Lineage of Survival. You gain resistance to the condition your chosen nature release inflicts and if you begin your turn with ranks of Envenomed, you can spend 1 Draconic Chakra, to reduce the associated ranks by 1.

Unbreakable Wyrm. All Ryu Clan Hijutsu you cast that require concentration, gains the Stable keyword for their duration.

Bloodline of Violence. Once per turn, when you cast a Ryu Clan Hijutsu and gain its Dragon Rage effect, you regain 1 Draconic Chakra.

Defiance of Fate

15th Level Clan Feature

The Dragon seed in your soul has sprouted, awakening one of the Dragons of legend within you whose name has long since been lost to time. It has been nurtured by your trials, tribulations, struggles, failures and successes. Now that it lives within you, it refuses to allow fate to determine your destiny. You gain the following benefits;

Untamable. While in your Dragon’s Rage, you must now have 5 ranks of Sealed to have it forcefully ended.

Dragon Kings Decree. When initiative is rolled, you can spend multiples of 5 Draconic Chakra to issue a fate defying declaration, which lasts until the end of combat. Select the Decrees you want to evoke;

Attacks you make and damage you deal cannot be intercepted by Barriers or other creatures.

Once per combat, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you defy fate and remain at 1 Hit point and enter your Awakened, Dragon’s Rage state at no additional Draconic Chakra cost, removing all current conditions you have as part of its activation.

Effects that would change or replace your dice roll result instead always allows you to reroll, taking the higher result.
